methods_and_caveats.dense: 紧凑稠密参照；保留两个活跃叶的 FP32 残差，不删坐标。
methods_and_caveats.topk50: 原幅值 Top-K，每叶保留 130 个输入坐标；作为既有 50% 稀疏方案参照。
methods_and_caveats.contrast: 固定正交动作对比基，移除四个动作共同加值的 softmax 冗余；代数上精确，概率探针阈值为 2e-5。完整 Adam 状态可能超过 3,648 B 同预算。
methods_and_caveats.center_topk50: 先减去动作公共行均值，再按权重幅值做 50% Top-K；用于隔离中心化效果。
methods_and_caveats.activation_topk50: 在相同中心化后按 |w_ij| × sqrt(E[φ_j²]) 剪枝；是受 Wanda 启发的改编，不是原论文完整复现。
methods_and_caveats.columns32: 按中心化列范数与特征 RMS 保留 31 个特征列及必保偏置列，整列动作权重一起保存；使用紧凑稠密乘法。
methods_and_caveats.svd2: 在动作对比坐标中作截断 rank-2 SVD，以平方根奇异值初始化两个可训练因子；每叶 136 个浮点坐标。
methods_and_caveats.svd2_distilled: 与 svd2 相同表示，再用过去在线校准观测作固定 500 步教师 KL 蒸馏；lr=0.005、梯度范数上限 1，不按测试回报调参。
methods_and_caveats.bf16: 残差值和原生 Adam 两个动量用 BF16 持久保存，forward 临时转 FP32；基础 actor、critic 及其 Adam 仍是 FP32。状态精度变化属于方法本身，不代表硬件加速。

figure_note: Each plotted marker is one of three existing checkpoint seeds; no confidence intervals or independent-seed inference.
caveats: All arms use a fresh Adam cohort; do not compare causally with the previous warm-Adam Top-K repair.
Past online CW/CCW trajectories are repurposed as calibration; no new environment interactions or test rewards train the compressor.
svd2_distilled uses 500 fixed teacher-KL updates; construction time includes distillation and the schema has no separate distillation timer.
All arms use the same 8192-step continuation budget; no fewer-interactions claim.
Three checkpoints share one foundation training seed; finite-sample gates are descriptive, not statistical guarantees.
Failure records are retained in this analysis; methods were not fully hyperparameter tuned.
No Part C, new task family, shared parent, or full-capacity consolidation is tested.
